abstract: In a synthetic benchmark modeling an air-gapped financial-operations setting, a deterministic mock-execution instrument separates declared tool selection from simulated privilege-changing effects. Four practitioners labeled the 198 non-trap tasks, with mean pairwise linear-weighted tier kappa 0.846. Across 13 serving configurations from Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 spanning five model sizes (7B–72B) and three configured precision labels, the conditional missed-escalation rate on four declared-equals-gold tools (12 tasks) averaged 80.1% under concealed descriptions,64.1% under disclosed descriptions,and78.8% under a word-count/structure-matched placebo. These are finite-benchmark rates,not population estimates. Related model configurations and repeated instances of the same tools are not independent replications. The findings demonstrate that the recorded selection criterion can miss the mock-execution effects represented by this benchmark; production transfer and verified runtime precision remain unestablished.
h1: The audit-revised H1 analysis reports within-family paired comparisons on the198 non-trap tasks. Qwen2.5-7B versus32B at FP16 yielded34 versus10 over-privileged selections,RD+12.1pp; Llama-3.1-8B versus70B at the configured INT8 condition yielded42 versus6,RD+18.2pp. Exact McNemar tests gave raw p values1.1920929e-7 and1.0087482e-7,respectively. Applying Holm correction to these two explicitly audit-revised comparisons gave adjusted p≈2.0174964e-7 for each. These calculations assume independent paired task units;template/domain dependence limits generalization. Qwen3-8B versus32B at FP16 is reported separately as exploratory (RD+10.6pp,p9.5367432e-7). The earlier GLMM+2.519 estimate came from16 configurations including exploratory cells;it is not retained as a verified12-configuration estimate,and no new GLMM refit is claimed.
h2: No empirical scale-by-quantization interaction conclusion is drawn. The previous pooled DiD+0.0841 used non-comparable legacy cells and is retained only in the audit trail,not as a valid interaction estimate. The grid and recorded precision evidence do not support the stated cross-family estimand. Missing cells include Qwen2.5-72B FP16,Llama-3.1-70B FP16,and Llama-3.1-8B FP16;they are not all large-model cells. Future comparisons require a declared family-matched estimand,verified loaded precision,and appropriate common cells.
h3: The original contrast was attack versus all non-attack tasks,not normal-only tasks. Normal-only III-Gap is0.0pp; the legacy non-attack group includes normal,legitimate-high-tier,and pre-correction trap outcomes and has−25.0pp. The matched exploratory contrast restricts to gold tiers1–3 and excludes traps/legitimate-high-tier tasks. For the original12 configurations,the attack-minus-normal difference is+10.5pp with a six-domain resampling95% percentile interval[+2.9,+20.3]pp (864 attack and1080 normal records). For all18 configurations,it is+10.6pp,[+1.9,+24.2]pp (1296 and1620 records). The discrete six-cluster intervals are descriptive/exploratory;they do not remove corpus stratification or dependence.
primary: The main endpoint is reported as an observed finite-benchmark rate,with per-tool and per-configuration counts. Task-binomial Wilson intervals are assumption-dependent descriptions because three tasks share each tool. The13-configuration sign-test arithmetic treats related precision variants as separate observations;it is not presented as independent confirmatory evidence. A checkpoint-level sensitivity comparison gives five positive,one tied concealed-minus-disclosed contrasts across six checkpoints (illustrative two-sided sign p=.0625),not a substitute well-powered tool-level test. The placebo result is consistent with sensitivity to disclosure content,but failure to detect a placebo-concealed difference is not an equivalence test.
measurement: Execution here means a deterministic mock-state transition driven by the authored tool-to-effect mapping,not execution of real SSH,database,IAM,or audit-management tools. The binary impact score is measured from the simulated state predicates. Runtime weight dtype,original full repeated responses,and historical state snapshots are not established by the released records. The term air-gapped describes the benchmark scenario unless actual serving isolation is separately documented.
discussion: The observations motivate separating declared-authority logs from independently observed effects. They do not establish80.1% as a lower bound for richer workflows or64.1% as a lower bound for other documentation regimes. Multi-tool controls and documentation variants could change outcomes in either direction. Operational authorization caps in this benchmark are synthetic design fields,not independently observed institution permissions. Dual-confirmed and missed-escalation categories must remain distinct;an AND-only diagnostic cannot define every adverse execution.
